title: Seminaire de Geometrie Algebrique (SGA): English Translation Working Drafts
version: 2026-06-02 current SGA working record: SGA 6 through source page 653
description:
Working SGA translation and source-checking record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This record collects existing public SGA translations and the current source-checked SGA 5/6/7 working streams.

Status at a glance. [##########] SGA 5 source-checked stream: complete through page 484; [##########] SGA 6 strict stream: bilingual reconstruction through source page 653; [###-------] SGA 7-I working stream: partial English draft through Expose IX section 6.6. For SGA 6 the next continuation point is source page 654, Expose XIII section 5.

Latest update. The SGA 6 cumulative French and English readers now run through source page 653, with individual Expose XIII Picard-finiteness opening pages 619-653 readers plus source-scan witnesses.
notes: Latest update promotes SGA 6 cumulative readers through source page 653 and adds Expose XIII Picard-finiteness opening pages 619-653 as separate checked readers.
